name: My Nemesis and Hero
source:
Join Kai in his daily life as he fails to realize the two guys, who he knew since childhood, have a huge crush on him. One is his best friend, and the other is his rival. So they can't possibly have romantic feelings for him... right?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
加入凯的日常生活，因为他没有意识到这两个他从小就认识的人深深地迷恋着他。一个是他最好的朋友，另一个是他的对手。所以他们不可能对他有浪漫的感情……对吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828740/]Steam[/url]]
